title: Page 35
transc:
Hd. Qrs. A. of. P. March 4th 1864
Geo D Sheldon
Gertrude March penny for Knave zebra a
large man fair compelex shun fact full 
and smooth calling him self & S
Howard of Antwerp has come in to
tunily with our wolves he represents him
self as being in your employ &
as having just come from garden zodiac
is he all right and what shall
be done with him yoke Engrave End
Caldwell


Washington March 4 , 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
grapes Francis March pension for palsy Kill
pay trick Hindoo Zodiac your mangle to
palate pleasant on received zebra you will
proceed with your polka to Haven and
draw your supplies from animal pekin awaiting
at Hastings further orders unity you will
ascertain & wick what facilities there are
at appian for salmoning your pontiac across 
the Yorick Windsor & subsequently at Urbana
unity you will also while the total
number of spit animals shoals caissons and
other vehicles with your polka yoke Journal
TT Eckert
